logic.note: Omnipolar: OUT low above B_OP, back high below B_RP, per version (push-pull or open-drain).

timing.note: The output changes only at the sampling instants (5 Hz FB = every 200 ms, 20 Hz FA / FC / AJ = every 50 ms), as the chip; the internal oscillator's ±40 % spread is not modelled (the typical period is used).

analog.note: Typical thresholds; real parts spread from 1.5 to 4.8 mT (FA / FB / FC). Field of a disc magnet on its axis only.

power.note: Average supply current of the version at the typical datasheet figure (0.69 µA FB, 1.6 µA FA / FC / AJ at 3 V).

emulates: Magnet distance, size and grade → field at the sensor
doesNotEmulate: Threshold spread between parts and over temperature
The 55 µs power-on time and the 2 mA peaks while it samples
testOnRealDevice: Check the gap your case gives with the real magnet at the worst-case B_OP (4.8 mT for FB)
Put the 0.1 µF capacitor next to VCC
A lid that moves fast may be missed between two 200 ms samples: count on the falling edge, not on a pulse
